name: opencode
description: The open source AI coding agent (TUI + headless server). CrossForge's flagship build.

license.notes: Upstream LICENSE is MIT (Copyright (c) 2025 opencode). Redistribution of compiled binaries is permitted with license notice. CrossForge ships upstream LICENSE + a NOTICE file inside every archive.

requiresNativeLibs.name: libopentui.so
requiresNativeLibs.reason: TUI renderer; @opentui/core has no official android-arm64 npm package

notes: Build matrix driver is based on upstream packages/opencode/script/build.ts (MIT) with added android-arm64 target and --targets selector.
Embedded web UI is skipped for the android target to keep the Termux artifact small and because the TUI is the primary interface there.
